okatova-2021.note: Published 29-item Russian adaptation. The full questionnaire and scoring key appear in Appendix 1; original QCAE items 1 and 17 are excluded.

kim-2018.note: Master’s thesis validating a 26-item Korean K-QCAE. The supplied Appendix 3 contains the questionnaire; original QCAE items 1, 14, 17, 18, and 28 are excluded.

di-girolamo-2019.note: The paper validates a 31-item Italian translation but does not reproduce the exact Italian item wording.

liang-2019.note: The paper confirms a translated and back-translated 31-item Chinese form, but the exact Chinese item wording is not reproduced in the article PDF.
